newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks close 3.04 pct lower, foreigners sell.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks close 3.04 pct lower, foreigners sell.

text.p: Foreigners joined local investors in selling stocks, especially finance and banking issues, on Friday as market sentiment was dampened by heavy declines on Wall Street overnight, brokers said.
"Market sentiment was poor throughout the day after heavy falls on Wall Street and some Asian markets today," said Bunsom Kesapradist of Asia Credit.
The SET composite index fell 21.77 points, or 3.04 percent, to close at 694.91 on 4.2 billion baht turnover.
